name: lv_tick_get

ownership.argument: Borrowed live page-owned LVGL object/event/input device; output coordinate buffer borrowed for call; no retention.

provenance.source: Returns configured tick callback or firmware tick counter; same tick_get called by native pointer timers. Startup 0xc0c0ac8 copies [0x2c10d440,0x2c18d940) to PSRAM 0x3c000000, executable alias 0x1c000000; load address 0xc17114c maps to runtime 0x1c063d0c, callable 0x1c063d0d. Exact XIP veneer 0xc588dc0 independently targets 0x1c063d0d.

notes: Target-private native UI host only. Static recovery does not grant public callable approval or device verification.
